title: Zoroastrian Middle Persian Corpus and Dictionary (MPCD)
institution: Ruhr-Universität Bochum; Freie Universität Berlin; Universität zu Köln
language_scope: Zoroastrian Middle Persian in Book Pahlavi; Avestan links for Zand texts
data_type: Manuscript-grounded transliteration, transcription, lemma, morphology, semantics, selected syntax

primary_evidence.finding: DFG project2021–2030; annotated Zoroastrian corpus and comprehensive dictionary; Zand receives Avestan word links.
September2025 poster describes approximately800,000tokens, multiple annotation layers and a Middle Persian–English dictionary.

access_and_license: Open-access aim is explicit; public bulk release, API accessibility and corpus reuse license not verified. Project-site direct requests returned403; indexed project pages and university pages were readable.
scale: Approximately800,000tokens in project description; not verified as released downloadable volume.
translation_alignment: Token meanings and Avestan–Pahlavi alignment; no verified800k-token English sentence-parallel corpus.
utility: Inference: strongest institutional source for linguistic annotation, terminology and a future corpus partnership.
limitations: Ongoing project; Zoroastrian domain differs from administrative and Manichaean texts.

title: MPCD Kosh dictionaries and glossaries
language_scope: Middle Persian; definitions from multiple scholarly dictionaries
data_type: XML lexical resources with normalized transcription and combined search

primary_evidence.finding: Some digitized dictionaries are public through Kosh; harmonized transcription follows MacKenzie1971. Listed resources include MacKenzie/Kölligan2012, Moazami2014/2020 and finite-verb/technical-term lists.
Mondaca,Rezania,Čéplö,Neuefeind describe the corpus/lexicon platform and REST/GraphQL architecture.

access_and_license: Public search URL https://www.mpcorpus.org/kosh/; indexed documentation verified, live interactive search and bulk exports untested. No dataset reuse license verified.
scale: Multiple dictionaries; entry total not established.
translation_alignment: Lexical senses and attestations rather than sentence translations.
utility: Inference: retrieve attested senses and verb forms before generating a translation.
limitations: Public subset only; source dictionaries and normalization versions must remain attributable.

title: MPCD annotation handbooks and methodology
institution: MPCD; Universität zu Köln; Ruhr-Universität Bochum; Freie Universität Berlin
language_scope: Middle Persian with explicitly separate spelling, pronunciation and lemma representations
data_type: Text-encoding, morphology, syntax and lexicography handbooks; UD-compatible analysis

primary_evidence.finding: Handbooks adapt Universal Dependencies to Middle Persian morphology/syntax; paleography and lexicography guides are under construction.
Dictionary-based preannotation is corrected by philologists; automatic and manually reviewed annotations remain distinguishable. Context disambiguates grammatical function and meaning.
Official FU project links this GitLab handbook; rendered content was not available to the text browser.

access_and_license: Indexed public documentation; no verified downloadable licensed parser/treebank. Proposed neural replacement of rules is not evidence of an already released model.
translation_alignment: Contextual token senses and dependencies can support translation; not a translation benchmark.
utility: Inference: reuse the annotation vocabulary and review workflow instead of inventing a Pahlavi schema.
limitations: No measured translation gains reported by these resource pages.

title: TITUS Middle Persian text collections
language_scope: Separate Zoroastrian, Manichaean and Christian Middle Persian collections; also Parthian and other languages
data_type: UTF-8 HTML text, indexes, transliteration and sometimes transcription

primary_evidence.finding: Lists Bundahišn, Ardā-virāf, Dēnkard4–7, Kārnāmag, Mēnōg-i xrad, Yasna/Vispered and minor texts with contributor credits; unavailable desiderata are distinguished.
Downloadable texts permitted for attributed scholarly use; commercial use excluded; some access restricted.
Restricted-access user declaration includes further copying/distribution conditions.

access_and_license: Public catalog; tested Kārnāmag/Ardā-virāf links reached legacy frames without extracted content. Scholarly noncommercial terms, not an unrestricted training-data license.
scale: Numerous named works; verified token total unavailable.
translation_alignment: Primarily source texts; no general English/Farsi parallel layer verified.
utility: Inference: corpus coverage, passage identifiers and original-edition tracing.
limitations: Overlaps other editions; preserve work-level provenance and distinguish languages.

title: Invisible East Digital Corpus: Middle Persian documents
institution: University of Oxford, Department for Continuing Education
language_scope: Middle Persian in Pahlavi script, filtered separately from New Persian and other corpus languages
data_type: Transcription, transliteration, English translation, document/editor/publication metadata

primary_evidence.finding: Indexed language filter shows158records; offers DOCX,JSON,XML exports.
Berk.67recto has four numbered source and English lines, editorThomasBenfey, Gold review status, referencesWeber2013/Benfey2024.
Welcomes reuse with attribution, including original publication and contributing editors.
MIT website code documents full JSON export endpoint /corpus/downloaddata/json/.

access_and_license: Public records and advertised bulk export; export not downloaded. Data reuse invitation with attribution; MIT applies to website code, not automatically every adapted edition.
scale: 158MiddlePersian records in a3-week-old indexed response; not158verified complete translated documents. Other pages have newer total-corpus counts.
translation_alignment: Numbered line alignment directly verified for one document; corpus-wide completeness unmeasured.
utility: Inference: highest-priority candidate for new real parallel data and documentary holdouts.
limitations: Uncertain readings survive in both texts; dates on sample have internal inconsistency; duplicate shelfmarks across collections require checking.

title: Open Archive of Middle Persian Documents

primary_evidence.finding: Names AdamBenkato as leader; worldwide document-edition project remains in development.
Live retrieved landing page advertises152documents and CC BY-NC-SA4.0.
Document page exposes ePUB/XML options, but text extraction showed loading shell.

access_and_license: CC BY-NC-SA4.0 displayed. XML/DTS/API interfaces advertised; functional document exports and API access not tested.
translation_alignment: Not verified from extracted document content.
utility: Inference: structured source editions and provenance, complementing Oxford documentary translations.
limitations: Rendering errors prevent equating document count with usable parallel pairs; likely shared manuscript coverage must be audited.

title: MIRTEXT / WMIRTEXT: published Manichaean Middle Persian and Parthian
institution: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities; Manichaean Dictionary Project
language_scope: Middle Persian and Parthian in Manichaean script; occasional Sogdian/Uighur explicitly distinguished
data_type: Unicode diplomatic/composite editions with manuscript and publication references

primary_evidence.finding: Describes checked published texts underpinning Durkin-Meisterernst2004 dictionary; duplicates combined, unpublished texts excluded.
German-page download successfully opens a1,303-page text PDF with language markers and line/manuscript references.

access_and_license: Public PDF; no corpus reuse license verified. English-page /bilder-en/mirtext.pdf link is404; German-page link works.
translation_alignment: No English/Farsi sentence alignment verified in this corpus file.
utility: Inference: substantial authentic monolingual material and lexical attestation source.
limitations: Mixed languages, reconstructed passages and composite witnesses; editorial markers must remain meaningful.

title: BBAW selected Manichaean Middle Persian texts with German translations
institution: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Turfanforschung
researchers: David Neil MacKenzie and W. B. Henning cited as underlying editors
language_scope: Manichaean Middle Persian; one section also includes Sogdian
data_type: Transliteration, phonological transcription, German translation and commentary

primary_evidence.finding: Official academy index links translated texts by language.
Readable23-page PDF; five headings include Mani’s last audience,M3; Šābuhragān; gospel beginning; magical text; omen text. Opening passages give consecutive source/transcription/German renderings.

access_and_license: Public PDF; no explicit text reuse license verified.
scale: 23pages; five named sections; aligned-pair count unmeasured.
translation_alignment: Passage-level three-layer correspondence directly observed; German target.
utility: Inference: expert alignment seed, semantic test passages, or reviewed German-to-English/Farsi bridge.
limitations: Machine-translated target bridge would be synthetic; first-page compiler attribution not explicit; overlaps MIRTEXT.

title: Pahlavi Psalter arranged by textual units, glossary and index (2012)
category: comparative edition and cautionary alignment example
institution: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities, Turfanforschung
researchers: Andreas–Barr cited for Syriac interlinear text
language_scope: Christian Middle Persian; Syriac, Greek and English comparison texts
data_type: Pahlavi textual units with multilingual parallels, glossary and index

primary_evidence.finding: 38-page academy-hosted summer-school edition explicitly states that the English column is KingJames, not a translation of the MiddlePersian text.

access_and_license: Public PDF; no explicit reuse license verified.
translation_alignment: Shared biblical-unit references; English is a comparable parallel version, not gold source translation.
utility: Inference: comparative interpretation and glossary; useful negative example for data-ingestion rules.
limitations: Do not train MiddlePersian-to-English gold pairs simply by matching psalm numbers; lacunae and differing textual traditions matter.

title: Multimedia Yasna: digital transcriptions and editions
category: critical edition and reusable editorial workflow
institution: SOAS University of London; University of Birmingham software collaboration
language_scope: Primarily Avestan Yasna; Pahlavi translations/commentary and ritual directions in selected witnesses; Sanskrit version
data_type: TEIP5 manuscript transcriptions, variants and critical apparatus

primary_evidence.finding: Explicit CC BY4.0; online/offline transcription editor produces TEIP5; CollateX and CollationEditor used. Bilingual commentary is distinguished from translation.

access_and_license: Transcriptions/editions CC BY4.0; https://transcriptions.soas.ac.uk/ linked, but returned no extracted content. Bulk export not verified.
scale: Around30manuscript witnesses per Avestan edition;8for Sanskrit; no Pahlavi token/pair count established.
translation_alignment: Historical Avestan–Pahlavi correspondence, distinct commentary; no general Pahlavi–English corpus verified.
utility: Inference: licensed annotation and variant-aware editing model; supports separating translation from exegesis.
limitations: Many witnesses repeat the same passage; manuscript count is not independent training-example count.

title: Corpus Avesticum Berolinense (CAB)
category: linked Avestan corpus and historical translation context
institution: Freie Universität Berlin, Institute of Iranian Studies
language_scope: Avestan, with linked MiddlePersian Zand through MPCD; not OldPersian or ModernPersian
data_type: Linguistic/liturgical corpora, manuscript transcriptions, lexicon and ritual-context tools

primary_evidence.finding: Official scope is editing the Avestan corpus within ritual context.
MPCD links Zand words to CAB Avestan text and lemmata.
Disclaimer provides institutional copyright notice; no specific data license identified.

access_and_license: Public web tools; footer saysCC without a verified variant. Do not infer a CreativeCommons license; API/bulk release not verified.
scale: Entire-corpus aim; accessible token total unverified.
translation_alignment: Avestan source contextualizes Pahlavi translation and exegesis, not direct English/Farsi gold labels.
utility: Inference: resolve Zand quotations, ritual vocabulary and source-text references.
limitations: Avestan is a distinct language and is not interchangeable with MiddlePersian.

title: Digital Turfan Archive and collection metadata
institution: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities; Staatsbibliothek zu Berlin; Göttingen Academy collaboration
researchers: Abdurishid Yakup, project head named on page
language_scope: Many languages/scripts; ManichaeanMiddlePersian and PahlaviPsalter are specific subsets
data_type: Digitized fragments, shelfmarks and links to editions

primary_evidence.finding: Collection table distinguishes roughly3,500mixed-language M-group fragments from12PahlaviPsalter fragments; total collection approximately40,000fragments.

access_and_license: Public archive; page requires notice for publication/reproduction, permission for redistribution of reproductions and special commercial permission. No unrestricted data license established.
scale: Mixed-language M-group~3,500fragments/3,606images; Psalter12fragments/22images; not translation-pair counts.
utility: Inference: preserve manuscript provenance, resolve duplicate witnesses and locate scholarly text editions; no OCR work proposed.
limitations: Large image counts must not be advertised as available typed or translated corpora.
